app ProbeB3g
use std {EmailV1 as Mail} from=deployment.mail
Given
 Order {reference:text unique, state:text="draft"}
 Line in Order {sku:text, accepted:int min=0, ordered:int min=0}
 Receipt in Line {source:text unique, accepted:int min=0, posting:text?}
 policy Order read=members
 policy Line read=members
 policy Receipt read=members
When
 crud Order by=members fields=reference
 crud Line by=members fields=sku
 crud Receipt by=members fields=source,accepted
 scenario receive(line:Line,source:text,accepted:int) -> Receipt by=members
  do
   create Receipt {parent=line,source,accepted} as receipt
   set line.parent {state="part"}
   return receipt
Then
